texts.title: 课文一：问问题
texts.setting: 在教室里，下课后，白家月问王老师问题。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 王老师，我可以再问您一个问题吗？
lines.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī, wǒ kěyǐ zài wèn nín yí gè wèntí ma?
lines.english: Ms. Wang, may I ask you one more question?

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.english: Yes, of course. What's your question?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.pinyin: Nàge xiǎo diàn mài bu mài shǒujī?
lines.english: Does that small shop sell cell phones?

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 我不知道。你可以打电话问一下。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào. Nǐ kěyǐ dǎ diànhuà wèn yíxià.
lines.english: I'm not sure. You can call to ask.

texts.title: 课文二：吃早饭
texts.setting: 在咖啡馆里，王一雪想吃早餐。

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.pinyin: Nǚshì, qǐng zuò! Nín hē shénme?
lines.english: Madam, have a seat, please! What would you like to drink?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 我看一下。请给我一杯牛奶。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kàn yíxià. Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi niúnǎi.
lines.english: Let me have a look. I'll have a glass of milk, please.

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de. Nín hái yào shénme?
lines.english: Alright. Would you like anything else?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 我还没吃早饭，再要这个面包和鸡蛋吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi chī zǎofàn, zài yào zhège miànbāo hé jīdàn ba.
lines.english: I haven't had breakfast yet, so I'll have bread and eggs.

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.pinyin: Xiānsheng, qǐng zuò! Nín yào shénme?
lines.english: Sir, have a seat, please! What would you like to order?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.english: I'd like one jin of jiaozi.

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de. Yì jīn jiǎozi sìshí gè.
lines.english: Alright. One jin of jiaozi has forty pieces.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.pinyin: Sìshí gè tài duō le, wǒ yào yíbàn ba.
lines.english: Forty is too many. I'll have half of that.

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.hanzi: 半斤 20 个。您想喝什么？
lines.pinyin: Bàn jīn èrshí gè. Nín xiǎng hē shénme?
lines.english: Half is twenty. What would you like to drink?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi chá ba.
lines.english: I'll have a cup of tea, please.
